args: repo="${YOUR_TURN_REPO:-$HOME/dev/your-turn}"; if [ -f "$repo/pyproject.toml" ]; then cd "$repo" && exec uv run --quiet yourturn mcp; fi; exec uvx --quiet --from git+https://github.com/martin-gomola/your-turn yourturn mcp
your-turn.note: Runs from a repo checkout at $YOUR_TURN_REPO or $HOME/dev/your-turn when present, otherwise from GitHub through uvx. The first uvx start downloads the package.
